definition: Defines the platform as the parent entity and records accountable ownership, environment and hosting classification.
mandatoryAttributes: Domain name; steward; status
relationshipRule: Root domain

definition: Technology, service or product being monitored, governed and assured.
mandatoryAttributes: Platform Name; Platform Type; Environment; Platform Owner; Hosting Model; Status
relationshipRule: Platform 1:M Data Sources; Platform 1:1 Governance Profile
notes: Authoritative parent entity

definition: Business or service owner accountable for the platform outcome and lifecycle.
mandatoryAttributes: Name or team; contact; accountability scope
relationshipRule: One primary owner per platform

definition: Team accountable for technical operation, maintenance and support.
mandatoryAttributes: Name or team; support group; escalation contact
relationshipRule: One or more technical owners per platform

definition: Team accountable for security controls, monitoring and security review.
mandatoryAttributes: Name or team; security responsibilities
relationshipRule: One security owner per platform

definition: Accountable person or role that accepts and reviews residual risk.
mandatoryAttributes: Name or role; delegation; review date
relationshipRule: One accountable risk owner per platform

definition: The operational lifecycle environment in which the system, application or component runs.
mandatoryAttributes: Production; Non-production; Development; Test; Staging; Disaster recovery
relationshipRule: One lifecycle environment value per system hosting context; multiple contexts are allowed where production, non-production or disaster-recovery environments differ.
notes: Example values: Production; Non-production; Development; Test; Staging; Disaster recovery. Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: The general deployment and hosting arrangement for the system or application.
mandatoryAttributes: On-premises; Cloud; Hybrid; Managed service; SaaS; To be confirmed
relationshipRule: One hosting model per system hosting context.
notes: Example values: On-premises; Cloud; Hybrid; Managed service; SaaS; To be confirmed. Wordpress value: Cloud.

definition: The cloud responsibility and service model applicable to the hosted system or application.
mandatoryAttributes: IaaS; PaaS; SaaS; Managed container platform; Serverless; Not applicable
relationshipRule: Required where the Hosting Model is Cloud, Hybrid, Managed service or SaaS.
notes: Wordpress value: Not provided; depends on whether Wordpress runs on Azure Virtual Machines, Azure App Service, AKS or another Azure service.

definition: The geographic region, country, jurisdiction or data-residency boundary in which the system and its data are hosted.
mandatoryAttributes: Region; country; jurisdiction; data-residency boundary where applicable
relationshipRule: One or more region or residency values may be associated with each system hosting context.
notes: Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: Defines the Splunk Deployment Server as a managed platform and management-plane service responsible for distributing configuration to supported deployment clients.
mandatoryAttributes: Platform ID; hostname; environment; owner; version; managed platform; availability; status
relationshipRule: A Deployment Server platform may manage many deployment clients. Collection-specific server classes, deployment apps and client assignments are governed under TAX-03.03.05.
notes: Use this heading for the Deployment Server platform itself. Do not use it as the primary record for server classes, deployment apps or event-collection configuration; those belong under TAX-03.03.05 — Deployment Server Collection Management.

definition: Defines the core identity, classification and key technology of the platform, system or application.
mandatoryAttributes: Platform; System ID; System Name; System Type; System Application Type; System Key Technology
relationshipRule: A platform or system has one primary identity profile and may have multiple technology classifications.
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Stable identifier for the source system, application, platform, data source or selected taxonomy record.
mandatoryAttributes: Identifier value
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Human-readable system, platform, application or source name.
mandatoryAttributes: System or platform name
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Classification of the system, platform, application or source type.
mandatoryAttributes: Source or platform type
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Application, service, workload or deployment class for the selected system.
mandatoryAttributes: Application or service type
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Primary vendor, product, technology stack or integration pattern used by the selected system.
mandatoryAttributes: Key technology or product
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Defines where the system, platform or application operates, how it is hosted, and how users, administrators and service identities authenticate to it.
mandatoryAttributes: Environment; Hosting model; Hosting provider; Region or data residency; Cloud account or tenant context where applicable; System authentication model; Identity provider
relationshipRule: A system, platform or application may have one or more hosting, cloud-account and authentication contexts, particularly where production, non-production or disaster-recovery environments differ.
notes: This section describes the hosting boundary, cloud account or tenant context, and authentication to the source system or application itself. Authentication used by Splunk collectors, Azure Functions, scripts, APIs, forwarders or HEC integrations remains under TAX-03.05 — Data Collection Authentication.

definition: The cloud provider, managed-service provider, datacentre authority or organisational hosting provider responsible for hosting the system.
mandatoryAttributes: Provider name; Hosting responsibility; Region where relevant
relationshipRule: One or more provider records may be associated with a system hosting context where hosting responsibilities are shared.
notes: Record cloud tenant, account, subscription, project, resource-group and resource identifiers under TAX-01.03.06 — Cloud Account / Tenant Context.

definition: Defines the cloud administrative, billing and resource hierarchy in which the system or application is hosted.
mandatoryAttributes: Cloud platform; Tenant/account/project identifier; Tenant/account/project name where available
relationshipRule: A system hosting context may link to one or more cloud account or tenant contexts where resources span tenants, accounts, subscriptions, projects or environments.
notes: Use this group for hosting-boundary identifiers. Do not use it for the identity provider used to authenticate application users.

definition: The cloud platform to which the tenant, account, subscription or project context belongs.
mandatoryAttributes: Cloud platform name
relationshipRule: Each cloud account or tenant context belongs to one cloud platform.
notes: Examples: Microsoft Azure; Amazon Web Services; Google Cloud.

definition: The human-readable name of the governing cloud tenant, AWS account or Google Cloud project.
mandatoryAttributes: Context name
relationshipRule: A cloud context may have one current display name and historical names may be retained where required.
notes: Azure example: Contoso Production Tenant.

definition: The immutable or authoritative identifier of the governing cloud tenant, AWS account or Google Cloud project.
mandatoryAttributes: Context identifier
relationshipRule: A cloud context identifier uniquely identifies the governing cloud boundary within its provider.
notes: Examples: Azure Tenant ID; AWS Account ID; GCP Project ID. Treat identifiers as metadata, not credentials.

definition: The human-readable name of the Azure subscription, GCP project or equivalent billing and resource-management boundary.
mandatoryAttributes: Subscription or project name
relationshipRule: A cloud tenant or account may contain one or more subscriptions or projects.
notes: For AWS, use the account name where no lower subscription boundary exists.

definition: The authoritative identifier of the Azure subscription, GCP project or equivalent resource-management boundary.
mandatoryAttributes: Subscription or project identifier
relationshipRule: A subscription or project identifier belongs to one governing cloud tenant or account context.
notes: Examples: Azure Subscription ID; GCP Project ID or Project Number.

definition: The higher-level cloud governance container used to group subscriptions, accounts or projects.
mandatoryAttributes: Management group, organisation or organisational-unit identifier/name
relationshipRule: A cloud context may inherit governance from one or more higher-level organisation containers.
notes: Examples: Azure Management Group; AWS Organization and OU; GCP Organization and Folder.

definition: The provider-specific logical container holding the system resources.
mandatoryAttributes: Resource container name and identifier where available
relationshipRule: A system may use one or more resource containers within a subscription, account or project.
notes: Examples: Azure Resource Group; GCP folder or project-level resource grouping; AWS resource grouping/tag boundary.

definition: The human-readable provider resource name for the hosted system component.
mandatoryAttributes: Resource name
relationshipRule: A system may map to one or more cloud resources.
notes: Examples: Azure Function App name, App Service name, virtual machine name or Kubernetes cluster name.

definition: The fully qualified provider resource identifier for the hosted system component.
mandatoryAttributes: Resource identifier
relationshipRule: Each cloud resource identifier should resolve to one resource within its provider hierarchy.
notes: Examples: Azure Resource ID; AWS ARN; GCP full resource name.

definition: Defines how users, administrators, services and other identities authenticate to the source system, platform or application.
mandatoryAttributes: Authentication model; Identity provider; Authentication protocol where known; SSO state; MFA state; Local-account state
relationshipRule: One or more authentication contexts may be associated with a system hosting context where different user populations, roles or interfaces use different authentication arrangements.
notes: Do not use this heading for credentials used by the logging integration. API keys, OAuth client credentials, managed identities and HEC tokens used for log collection belong under TAX-03.05. Wordpress summary — Authentication model: Federated authentication / SSO; Identity provider: Microsoft Entra ID; Authentication protocol: Not provided; MFA: Not provided; Local accounts: Not provided.

definition: The identity platform responsible for authenticating users or issuing authentication assertions or tokens to the application.
mandatoryAttributes: Identity provider name
relationshipRule: One or more identity providers may be associated with a system authentication context.
notes: Example values: Microsoft Entra ID; Active Directory Federation Services; Okta; Ping Identity; Local identity store; LDAP directory. Wordpress value: Microsoft Entra ID.

definition: The protocol or mechanism used between the application and its identity provider.
mandatoryAttributes: Protocol or authentication mechanism
relationshipRule: One or more protocols may be associated with an authentication context where different interfaces use different mechanisms.
notes: Example values: OpenID Connect; OAuth 2.0; SAML 2.0; LDAP; Kerberos; Integrated Windows Authentication; Local username and password. Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: Identifies whether the system participates in an organisational single sign-on arrangement.
mandatoryAttributes: SSO state
relationshipRule: One SSO state per authentication context.
notes: Example values: Required; Enabled; Optional; Disabled; Not applicable; Unknown. Wordpress value: Enabled or required, subject to confirmation.

definition: Identifies whether MFA is required for users, administrators or privileged roles accessing the system.
mandatoryAttributes: MFA state and covered population
relationshipRule: One or more MFA requirements may be recorded where controls differ by user population or role.
notes: Example values: Required for all users; Required for administrators; Enforced through Conditional Access; Optional; Not enabled; Unknown. Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: Identifies whether local application accounts or credentials remain available outside the federated identity provider.
mandatoryAttributes: Local authentication state
relationshipRule: One local-authentication state per authentication context, with exceptions recorded separately.
notes: Example values: Disabled; Break-glass only; Administrators only; Enabled; Not applicable; Unknown. Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: The application-side component, plugin, enterprise application or configuration that connects the system to the identity provider.
mandatoryAttributes: Integration component or configuration
relationshipRule: One or more authentication integrations may support an authentication context.
notes: Example values: Wordpress OpenID Connect plugin; Wordpress SAML plugin; Entra enterprise application; Application registration; Reverse-proxy authentication; Native identity integration. Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: The user populations, roles or interfaces covered by the authentication arrangement.
mandatoryAttributes: Covered population, role or interface
relationshipRule: One or more scopes may be associated with each authentication context.
notes: Example values: All users; Administrators only; Public website administrators; API users; Internal workforce; External users. Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: Records approved authentication exceptions such as service accounts, emergency access, local break-glass accounts or interfaces that cannot use the primary identity provider.
mandatoryAttributes: Exception type; justification; approval; owner; review or expiry date where applicable
relationshipRule: Zero or more approved exceptions may be associated with an authentication context.
notes: Wordpress value: Not provided.

definition: Defines program, project and delivery-management context for the platform, system or onboarding activity.
mandatoryAttributes: Program; Program Manager; Project; Project Manager
relationshipRule: Platform 1:M delivery ownership metadata fields
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Program, programme or portfolio that owns, sponsors or governs the system or onboarding activity.
mandatoryAttributes: Program or portfolio name
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record

definition: Person, role or team accountable for program-level delivery or ownership.
mandatoryAttributes: Program manager or accountable role
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Project, onboarding initiative or delivery activity associated with the selected system or source record.
mandatoryAttributes: Project or initiative name
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Person, role or team accountable for project delivery.
mandatoryAttributes: Project manager or accountable role
relationshipRule: One value per selected system, platform, application or source record
notes: Moved from TAX-02.10 into TAX-01 Platform & Ownership.

definition: Defines governance profiles, evidence, approvals, risk decisions, reviews, standards and compliance context for platforms, systems and logging services.

definition: Provides the consolidated governance profile for a platform, system or service.

relationshipRule: A platform or system may have one current governance profile and historical versions.

definition: Single governance summary associated with a platform.
mandatoryAttributes: Platform ID; owners; hosting model; governance status; next review
relationshipRule: Platform 1:1 Governance Profile

definition: Groups authoritative documents and artefacts used to demonstrate design, compliance, security and governance decisions.
mandatoryAttributes: Evidence type; title; owner; status; location
relationshipRule: A platform or system may reference multiple evidence artefacts.

definition: Evidence record linked to a governance profile.
mandatoryAttributes: Governance ID; Platform ID; Artifact Type; Status; Reference
relationshipRule: Governance Profile 1:M Artifacts

definition: Approved architecture, solution and implementation design evidence.
mandatoryAttributes: Document type; name; version; owner; status; reference
relationshipRule: Governance Profile 1:M Artifacts

definition: A governed diagram showing logical, physical, security-zone or service architecture.
mandatoryAttributes: Title; version; owner; location; approval status
relationshipRule: A platform or system may have multiple architecture views and versions.

definition: A governed representation of data movement, trust boundaries, processing points and destinations.
mandatoryAttributes: Title; version; owner; data flows; trust boundaries
relationshipRule: A platform or logging integration may have one or more data-flow diagrams.

definition: A governed assessment of threats, attack paths, mitigations and residual risks.
mandatoryAttributes: Method; scope; owner; version; review status

definition: Records the classification, sensitivity, handling and residency requirements of system and log data.

definition: Groups formal system approvals, accreditations and individual governance decisions.

definition: Approval state or governance decision for the system, platform, application or selected source record.

definition: Formal security or operational authorisation for a platform or service.
mandatoryAttributes: Authority; status; approval date; expiry; conditions

definition: Architecture, security, change or production approval decision.
mandatoryAttributes: Decision; authority; date; scope; conditions
relationshipRule: A platform, system, change or artefact may have multiple approval decisions.

definition: Identifies the person, role, committee or organisation authorised to approve the system or decision.
mandatoryAttributes: Authority name; role; organisation
relationshipRule: Each approval or accreditation identifies an accountable approval authority.

definition: The effective date on which an approval, accreditation or governance decision was granted.
mandatoryAttributes: Approval date

definition: The date on which an approval expires or must be formally reviewed.
mandatoryAttributes: Expiry or review date

definition: Groups risk assessments, accepted exceptions, residual risk and compensating controls.

definition: Assessment of threats, vulnerabilities, controls and residual risk.
mandatoryAttributes: Assessment type; residual risk; risk owner; review date; reference
relationshipRule: Zero or more assessments per platform

definition: Approved deviation from policy or control requirements.
mandatoryAttributes: Exception scope; rationale; risk rating; owner; expiry; compensating controls
relationshipRule: Zero or more exceptions per platform

definition: The risk remaining after existing and planned controls are applied.
mandatoryAttributes: Residual risk rating; rationale; owner
relationshipRule: A risk assessment or exception should record the accepted residual risk.

definition: Alternative controls used to reduce risk where the preferred requirement cannot be met.
mandatoryAttributes: Control; owner; implementation status; evidence

definition: Groups periodic governance, compliance and assurance review records and outcomes.
mandatoryAttributes: Review scope; owner; date; outcome; next review

definition: Periodic review of governance currency and evidence.
mandatoryAttributes: Last review; next review; outcome; reviewer
relationshipRule: Recurring review per platform

definition: The decision, findings, actions and status resulting from a governance review.
mandatoryAttributes: Outcome; findings; actions; status
relationshipRule: Each completed governance review should record an outcome.

definition: The scheduled date for the next governance or compliance review.
mandatoryAttributes: Next review date

definition: The expected cadence for governance, compliance or assurance review.
mandatoryAttributes: Frequency
relationshipRule: A governed system should have a defined review frequency where periodic review is required.

definition: Groups organisational standards, conventions and approved baselines applicable to platforms and logging services.
mandatoryAttributes: Standard type; owner; version; status
